data.gender_notes: Ambrosane is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ambrosia', meaning 'immortal' or 'everlasting'. In Greek mythology, ambrosia was the food of the gods, symbolizing eternal life. In a Christian context, Ambrosane could symbolize a strong spiritual connection or a deep faith that sustains and nourishes one throughout life. The name Ambrosane carries the meaning “Immortal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ambrosane usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
